quran.text: And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient.
quran.lesson: Patience during trials leads to divine rewards.

quran.text: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
quran.lesson: Every difficulty is accompanied by comfort; never lose hope.

quran.text: Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.
quran.lesson: You are stronger than your challenges; Allah never overburdens you.

quran.text: Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.'
quran.lesson: No matter your mistakes, the door of mercy is always open.

quran.text: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.
quran.lesson: Faith is the ultimate source of strength and victory.

quran.text: And He will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.
quran.lesson: Reliance on Allah opens doors you never knew existed.

quran.text: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
quran.lesson: Prayer and patience are the believers' two greatest tools.

quran.text: And rely upon Allah ; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
quran.lesson: Letting go and trusting Allah brings true peace of mind.

quran.text: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, My punishment is indeed severe.'
quran.lesson: Gratitude is the key to multiplying your blessings.

quran.text: And Allah would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.
quran.lesson: Seeking forgiveness is a shield against life's hardships.

quran.text: And when you have decided, then rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely [upon Him].
quran.lesson: Once you make a choice, trust in the divine plan.

quran.text: And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.
quran.lesson: Allah is closer to you than anyone; He hears every prayer.

quran.text: But seek, through that which Allah has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world.
quran.lesson: Balance your life between spiritual growth and worldly responsibilities.

quran.text: What would Allah do with your punishment if you are grateful and believe? And ever is Allah Appreciative and Knowing.
quran.lesson: Faith and gratitude are the paths to escaping hardship.

quran.text: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
quran.lesson: True tranquility is found only in connection with the Creator.

quran.text: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.
quran.lesson: Always remember the loving and forgiving nature of Allah.

quran.text: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.
quran.lesson: Sincere effort is always met with divine guidance.

quran.text: Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account.
quran.lesson: Subtle patience has rewards beyond any calculation.

quran.text: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
quran.lesson: You are never alone or forgotten by your Lord.

quran.text: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
quran.lesson: Life's trials are often for our own growth and purification.

bible.text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
bible.lesson: Divine strength allows you to overcome any obstacle.

bible.text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
bible.lesson: Trusting in God's providence removes the fear of lack.

bible.text: For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.
bible.lesson: God's love is the greatest gift and the key to eternal peace.

bible.text: And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are the called according to His purpose.
bible.lesson: Trust that everything happening in your life is part of a bigger, better plan.

bible.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.
bible.lesson: Surrendering your logic to divine wisdom leads to the right path.

bible.text: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.
bible.lesson: You are never alone, so face your fears with divine confidence.

bible.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
bible.lesson: In times of crisis, turn to the Creator for immediate support.

bible.text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.
bible.lesson: God's intentions for you are always focused on a bright and hopeful future.

bible.text: But those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles, they shall run and not be weary, they shall walk and not faint.
bible.lesson: Patience and waiting for the right time brings renewed energy and power.

bible.text: Come to Me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
bible.lesson: When stressed, spiritual connection is the true source of rest.
